'''Peldon Minor''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located within the [[Peldon Minor system/Legends|Peldon Minor system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located in the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that eventually became the [[Cassander subsector]],<ref name="Cassander" /> a part of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] participated in military actions at Peldon Minor and was later decorated for his efforts while fighting there.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peldon Minor was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Peldon Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Peldon Minor, within grid square L-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
